answer_1.quote: Although LLM-based methods already perform well on many multi-modal tasks, knowledge-based VQA remains a challenging task, which requires outside knowledge beyond the image content to answer the question.

answer_2.quote: To thoroughly compare our results against existing methods, various evaluation metrics are adopted to measure the model performance. Specifically, VQA Score is the most used metric in VQA task... Exact Match (EM) is also adopted as the evaluation metric in our work...
